name: HumanSupportRequest
description: Server-only support handoff request linked to a Help Desk conversation

conversation_token.description: Opaque local conversation token linked to the handoff

owner_user_id.description: Authenticated platform user id when available

owner_email.description: Normalized authenticated account email when available

requester_name.description: Bounded name supplied for human support

requester_email.description: Validated email supplied for human support

reason.description: Bounded visitor reason for requesting human support

summary.description: Bounded support summary assembled from the current handoff

resolution_summary.description: Bounded administrator-authored resolution summary, the only support text eligible for explicit learning promotion

status.description: Support status: NEW, IN_PROGRESS, or RESOLVED

requested_at.description: Server timestamp when support was requested

assigned_admin.description: Normalized administrator email assigned to the request

private_note.description: Bounded private administrator note, never used as learning input

resolved_at.description: Server timestamp when the request was resolved

last_updated_at.description: Server timestamp of the latest administrator update

last_updated_by.description: Administrator email that made the latest update

status_updated_at.description: Server timestamp when the status last changed

status_updated_by.description: Administrator email that last changed the status
